# Erin Dohan

> Erin Dohan is the author of the memoir *I Think I'm Ready to Talk: The Messy, Honest Story of Coming Back to Myself After a Ruptured Brain Aneurysm* (Koehler Books, September 9, 2026). She is a writer, wife, and mother in the western suburbs of Chicago.

At age 27, on May 29, 2019, Erin survived a ruptured brain aneurysm. The five years that followed brought miscarriage, emergency abortion, infertility, a complicated pregnancy, postpartum complications, ovarian torsion, and ultimately the removal of both ovaries, alongside a medical system that repeatedly dismissed or failed to believe her. The book covers May 2019 through September 2024.
